Five descriptions of the same entity, collected from different places.

---

SOURCE 1 — GitHub README, first line

> Marrowfield is an open-source feature-flag library for backend services that evaluates flags
> locally with no network call on the hot path.

---

SOURCE 2 — marrowfield.io homepage hero

> The experimentation platform for product teams. Ship confidently, measure everything, roll
> back in one click.

---

SOURCE 3 — startup directory listing

> MarrowField offers release management software for enterprise IT departments, helping
> operations teams control the rollout of internal applications across large user populations.

---

SOURCE 4 — founder's conference bio

> Tobias builds Marrowfield, a developer tool for gradual rollouts. Previously infrastructure
> at a streaming company.

---

SOURCE 5 — docs site landing page

> Marrowfield is a feature-flag library. Your service loads a ruleset at startup, keeps it in
> memory, and evaluates every flag check locally against that ruleset.
